name: headers
title: The module's pin headers (reference)
orientation: Not printed: 0.1 in male headers between the module and a board above it. The board's underside is z = 0.

flip.rule: -1: the module upside down under the board, so its pins mirrored left to right; 1: as seen from above

gap.rule: Each pin's spacer a hair under the pitch, so neighbours don't touch in the model

spacer.rule: The plastic spacer's height, between the boards
spacer.source: Standard 0.1 in male headers (2.5 mm spacer)

pin.source: Standard 0.1 in headers (0.64 mm square pins)

below.rule: Pins trimmed this far past the module

above.rule: Pins trimmed this far above the board, between the switches
